_what: Programs whose catalog section prints a total that its own printed figures do not add to, each read by a session from the page itself (never found by a pattern over free text). printed_total is the program total as printed; printed_sum is what the page's own units add to (each required course's printed units, and each list's printed figure where the page prints one). kb/_program_named_gaps.py names the gap total_differs on a listed record whose arithmetic is unequal and whose computed and stated figures are exactly printed_sum and printed_total, and the self-recall reads this file alone as the held answer. A record not listed here never takes the gap. Remove an entry to withdraw it.
